about_short_description.short_description: ANSR is providing end-to-end services for companies, setting up captive service centers.

product.name: Global Capability Center (GCC) Solutions
product.description: End-to-end services for establishing, operating, and scaling in-house Global Capability Centers, including talent, workspace, HR, operations, payroll, and compliance support.

product.name: 1Wrk
product.description: An integrated global work platform for coordinating talent, workspace, HR, operations, and payroll services used to build and manage Global Capability Centers.

product.name: Talent Solutions
product.description: Talent acquisition and workforce management services covering talent intelligence, sourcing, screening, hiring, employer branding, rewards, onboarding, and talent management.

product.name: Workspace Solutions
product.description: Fully managed workspace services covering location strategy, leasing, design, construction, IT infrastructure, hospitality, and day-to-day workspace operations.

product.name: Business Operations Services
product.description: Operational support for GCCs across human resources, payroll, legal, finance, tax, regulatory compliance, contracts, and employee lifecycle administration.

product.name: Research & Advisory
product.description: Consulting services for GCC strategy, organizational design, capability planning, location analysis, market intelligence, benchmarking, and total rewards.
